official_statement_rationale: While I acknowledge the moderation in core inflation to 4.10%, the headline CPI inflation at 5.55% remains uncomfortably close to the upper tolerance threshold. The persistent food inflation at 8.70%, exacerbated by the 6.0% monsoon rainfall deficit, continues to pose a significant risk to the durability of the disinflation process. Given the positive output gap of 0.60%, the economy is operating above its potential, which limits the scope for a change in the policy stance at this juncture. To ensure that inflation expectations remain anchored and to mitigate the risk of second-round effects from supply-side shocks, I believe it is prudent to maintain the current repo rate of 6.50% and continue with the withdrawal of accommodation.
